_key_type_source.reason: Upstream cosmos/chain-registry lists key_algos ["secp256k1", "ethsecp256k1"], but the chain has no Ethermint key support.
evidence: https://github.com/notional-labs/dig/blob/efe9eaf4508e9ba5c02b1943fbaaf36b5d1f4dfa/go.mod (no ethermint dependency; plain cosmos-sdk v0.44.5 fork) and no custom keyring options or coin type in cmd/ (SDK defaults: secp256k1, coin type 118); v3.6.0 go.mod also has no ethermint
